findings.title: Public file-request upload is permission-gated and unreachable for anonymous uploaders
findings.note: file-requests.ts:114-130 authorizes the public upload by the request token only; management routes remain permission-gated.

findings.title: File-request uploads have no tenant-scoped path and no download path; orphan cleanup will delete them
findings.note: org-prefixed path (file-requests.ts:160), file_request_uploads row (218), org-scoped list/signed-URL endpoints (343-390), orphan-cleanup reconciles file_request_uploads (orphan-cleanup.ts:169-190).

findings.title: Document version history objects are deleted at replace and by orphan cleanup
findings.note: documents.ts replace keeps the previous object (retention comment at ~:451), version signed URL at :961-1020, cleanup unions document_versions (:186-189).

findings.title: `avatars` bucket is used by code but declared nowhere with no storage RLS policy
findings.note: 5302433 declares the avatars bucket and owner-prefix policies.

findings.title: Free-form `storageBucket`/`storagePath` on create/update allows signing arbitrary in-bucket objects
findings.note: validators/document.ts:27 z.literal('documents') + path regex; documents.ts:284-287,549-556 org-prefix equality on create/update.

findings.title: No content/AV scanning and no bucket-level MIME/size limits on the documents bucket
findings.note: lib/malware-scan.ts exists and fails closed when MALWARE_SCANNER_URL is configured, but the default is a no-op and the documents bucket has file_size_limit only — allowed_mime_types is deliberately unset (5302439 comment).

findings.title: No backup or restore path for uploaded objects (durability for files)
findings.note: backup-storage.sh + restore-storage.sh + storage-backup.yml + storage-restore-test.yml present; the local exercise script is wired into CI (validate.yml:74). Residual: live restore drill still pending (drill ledger).

findings.title: Content sniffing does not cover Office, archive, text/JSON, or polyglot payloads
findings.note: upload-validation.ts:10-18,89-148,165-200 covers OOXML/OLE2/zip/gzip/7z/rar/tar/RTF/JSON/text and rejects polyglot mismatches.

findings.title: CSV exports do not neutralize formula injection and default to all rows when `organization_id` is omitted
findings.note: lib/csv.ts:9-25 formula guard; sendExportResponse/rowsToCsv used by 8 routes + 2 bespoke CSV exports, all org-scoped.

findings.title: Document download authorization bypasses the `can_read_document` visibility model
findings.note: canReadDocumentById enforced on download (documents.ts:661-663) and version signed URL (:972-983).

findings.title: Members with `documents:create` can write objects straight to the documents bucket, bypassing upload validation
findings.note: 5302439 drops the authenticated INSERT/UPDATE storage policies and sets the 25MiB bucket limit; API writes are service-role with validation.

findings.title: Share endpoint has no per-token rate limit
Client logo accept list still advertises SVG that the server rejects
findings.note: OrgBrandingForm.tsx:106 accept='image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif' matches the server map; test asserts it.

findings.title: Documentation drift on file types and size limits; no documents/upload runbook
findings.note: docs/runbooks/secure-file-request.md exists and matches the code, but docs/ORG_BRANDING.md:65 still advertises PNG/JPG/SVG with a 5MB limit (SVG is rejected) and docs/ARCHITECTURAL_ANALYSIS.md:274 still says documents 50MB/avatars 2MB.

findings.title: Storage restore path exists but has never been exercised
findings.note: bash scripts/exercise-storage-restore.sh -> PASS (6 checks: valid/no-manifest/count-mismatch/empty/encrypted-no-key/encrypted-with-key); wired at validate.yml:74.

findings.title: Share revocation does not invalidate already-issued signed URLs
Oversized uploads return 500 instead of a validation error
findings.note: middleware/error.ts:36-39 maps LIMIT_FILE_SIZE to 413 with a clear message.

findings.title: File-domain test gaps: no upload-validation unit tests and no file-request download coverage
Previews render untrusted files inline without sandbox or disposition controls
findings.note: preview-policy.ts:17-25,55-80 denies SVG/XML/HTML inline and forces attachment; web preview iframes sandboxed.

report: Read-only re-verification at `7dd0402`; no live Storage/bucket probing. 17 of 19 previous FILE rows verified fixed, 2 partially fixed, 0 regressed, 0 new. Executed: `bash scripts/exercise-storage-restore.sh` → PASS (6 checks). Key code: `routes/{documents,file-requests}.ts`, `lib/{upload-validation,preview-policy,malware-scan,csv,document-visibility}.ts`, `worker/tasks/orphan-cleanup.ts`; migrations 5302433/5302439. Residuals: malware scanning is an opt-in fail-closed hook (default no-op) and the documents bucket has no MIME allow-list (FILE-P2-003); `docs/ORG_BRANDING.md:65` and `docs/ARCHITECTURAL_ANALYSIS.md:274` still state stale types/sizes (FILE-P3-003).
